learning_outcomes.text: Students know, analyze, and evaluate the application and technical integration of actuators in mechatronic systems. They have fundamental knowledge about the structure and function of actuators as control and positioning systems.

They have fundamental knowledge that enables them to select and design electromagnetic actuators as control and positioning systems. As a result, system thinking and skills for system integration are acquired.

Students deepen the knowledge acquired in their Bachelor's degree and have detailed knowledge of actuators and their theoretical and practical functioning. They can evaluate and apply various actuator principles.
Latest research results are discussed and evaluated.

Students of Osnabrück University of Applied Sciences who have successfully completed this module possess specialized knowledge in the field of electrical drive technology and actuators. They can implement various methods for the design and construction of actuators.
Students apply the learned technical principles in practical projects in small groups.
Students work with the latest technologies developed in the research area at Osnabrück University of Applied Sciences.
Communicative competencies are applied during project work. Students present complex technical relationships and collectively weigh solution paths.

With the acquired knowledge, students gain a range of job-related skills and techniques to handle standard and advanced tasks. They learn how development tasks in the field of actuators are approached and successfully implemented in a company.

syllabus_topics: Actuators as main components of mechatronic systems, for executing movements or applying forces and moments
Actuators as active control elements in drive and control technology, controlled by process or microcomputer, converting electrical energy into mechanical work on the shaft or push rod.
Actuators in the action chain of a mechatronic system between control and regulation devices and the system/process to be influenced.
Control of movements, with applications like electromagnetic control and positioning drives, piezo actuators, or magnetostrictive actuators.
Actuator as a component of mechatronic systems
Rotating drives with the use of electric motors
assessment_rules: The graded examination performance can be either a term paper (approx. 15-25 pages, with an optional 15-minute explanation), a presentation (approx. 45 minutes), or a written project report (approx. 15-25 pages, with an optional 15-minute explanation).
